name: Grapefruit juice may raise simvastatin exposure
actions: Ask about grapefruit juice amount and frequency before interpreting this pair.
Avoid large quantities of grapefruit juice (more than one quart daily) with simvastatin, as directed in the product label.

rationale: Grapefruit juice can inhibit intestinal CYP3A and increase simvastatin exposure.
The effect varies markedly with grapefruit juice quantity and preparation; a selected pair does not establish intake.

explanation_template: Grapefruit juice can raise simvastatin exposure and muscle toxicity risk, especially with large quantities. The amount consumed is needed to interpret this interaction.

references.source: DailyMed, Simvastatin Tablets, Drug Interactions and Clinical Pharmacology
references.citation: Avoid more than one quart of grapefruit juice daily with simvastatin; pharmacokinetic effects vary by quantity.
